description: Forced six-step at duty 0.093, chosen so the current vector matches the FOC legs at about 0.53 A. Angle is forced, so this isolates the commutation scheme from the angle source.
notes: Matched-current leg of the three-scheme sweep on the small bench motor (flux 0.937 mWb, 7 pole pairs).
Ripple marginally resolved: 8.3 samples per ripple period.
title: Six-step (trapezoidal), 302 rad/s el
